title: [spec-gap][R-02AT-022] TDMA TX gate inert end-to-end: lichen_link_set_slot uncalled, TX gate uses now_ms=0, unsynced gate passes (spec 02a-tdma.md:63)
description: Spec 02a-tdma.md:63 SYNCED state: TX only in assigned slot, periodic beacon listen, Enforce tdma_tx_allowed(); and :64 DRIFTING suppresses TDMA TX. Classification: implemented+untested (the gate exists but is not operative). C: tdma_tx_allowed (lichen/subsys/lichen/link/tdma.c:303-338) IS called in the production TX path (lichen/subsys/lichen/link/lichen_link_tx.c:110-112, returns -EBUSY) but the call passes now_ms=0 with a FIXME (lichen_link_tx.c:99-109: real clock source REQUIRED before enabling synced operation), and tdma->synced is only set by lichen_link_set_slot() (tdma.c:263-284) which has NO production caller - so every node is permanently unsynced and tdma.c:305 returns true unconditionally, making the gate a no-op. Rust: tdma_clock::tx_allowed (rust/lichen-link/src/tdma_clock.rs:69-80) has no production caller (unit tests + tests/tdma_clock_vectors.rs only); lichen-node/src/tdma_scheduler.rs computes slots (:18-24) but never gates TX; gateway slot.rs is_tx_allowed (:246) uncalled. Python: the gate lives only in the simulator (TDMAScheduler.is_tx_allowed sim/tdma.py:94-117, live via sim/node.py:13,59,96); timing/tx_queue.py has no TDMA gate (:126-201 deadline/priority only). Semantics question: tdma.c:305 returning true while unsynced is the deliberate ALOHA-overlay fallback (comment lichen_link_tx.c:99-109), but 02a-tdma.md:61 says UNJOINED = CH0 listen only, no TX and :64 says suppress TDMA TX in DRIFTING - spec and code disagree on unsynced TX posture (see flagged set R-02AT-019/023). Related existing beads: b7z9.22 (slot_map end-to-end + root-side beacon builder), d7hg (DesyncFSM beacon-RX wiring), b7z9.17 (slot duration 250 vs 2346). Suggested placement: wire a real now_ms time source and a lichen_link_set_slot() caller (from beacon slot_map or hash derivation) into the C TX path; gate rust lichen-node TX on tdma_clock::tx_allowed with the adopted slot; document the UNJOINED/DRIFTING TX posture (strict no-TX vs contention-allowed) in 02a-tdma.md and align the unsynced branch of tdma_tx_allowed with it. From spec-coverage sweep 2026-09-09 (docs/spec-coverage/02a-tdma.md R-02AT-022/023).
